correctness.rationale: The root Voronoi-cell equality is proved in both directions from lattice inequalities; its projected-cube radius is exact. Each simple-root permutation simplex has an explicit rational center through all vertices with squared radius k(N-k)/N, verified by coordinate-case analysis. The bound for every permutation plus the literature μ≤κ comparison proves equality uniformly for all integers n≥5. The Eulerian frequency count follows from an inverse-permutation ascent bijection. The 46,387 exact finite tests are supplementary and not presented as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The κ-to-classical-covering ratio can grow like sqrt(n) on Euclidean lattice families. Proving exact equality throughout a canonical irreducible root-lattice family in all higher ranks, via one explicit optimal path-root frame, is a motivated structural result. Eulerian numbers classify a natural exact circumsphere statistic across the whole packet, rather than one arbitrary finite slice. The proof does not claim unknown optimal-frame uniqueness or a general theorem for all lattices.
